root.label: DR Power Equipment Pilot and Premier Trimmer Mowers recall

events.label: DR Power Equipment Pilot and Premier Trimmer Mowers recall

slots.name: recalled mowers
slots.sentence: DR Power Equipment has recalled more than 42,000 of its Pilot and Premier Trimmer Mowers because grass and debris can accumulate in the mower, ignite and pose a risk of serious injury or death from fire and burn, according to a CPSC recall report.

slots.name: fire reports
slots.sentence: As of Oct. 8, DR Power Equipment was aware of 19 reports of the mowers catching fire, including two reports of minor injuries, like blisters on hands and feet.

slots.name: units sold Canada
slots.sentence: The recalled mowers were sold at Ace, TSC, Bomgaars, and other home improvement, hardware and independent power equipment stores nationwide and online on the DR Power Equipment website from November 2022 through July 2026 for between $380 to $550, according to the recall report. Included in the total were 340 units sold in Canada.
